response.sql: WITH college_player_counts AS (SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(pc.player_id) as player_count FROM college c INNER JOIN player_college pc ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state), totals AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_players, AVG(player_count) as avg_player_count FROM college_player_counts), college_with_metrics AS (SELECT cpc.state, cpc.player_count, cpc.player_count / t.avg_player_count as relative_count, cpc.player_count / t.total_players as share FROM college_player_counts cpc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT COALESCE(state, 'blank') as state, AVG(player_count) as avg_players, AVG(relative_count) as avg_relative_count, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM college_with_metrics GROUP BY state
